utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Thursday the thirtieth. Have we got everyone who's in?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Think so. Tomasz is there, just muted.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, I'm here. Headset button and Teams button. Always the wrong one.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: We got the sigh before you muted it, mind.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: That was the chair.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: The furniture, I hope. Jamie Brennan and Olumide Adeyemi are absent today, so it's us six.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Before we start properly, there's a birthday cake in the office. Already cut, if anyone's wondering.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: That explains the queue past the printer.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: More interest in that than the biscuits, anyway.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Anything's better than watching the football last night. Honestly, ninety minutes of my life.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: You stayed till the end?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Unfortunately. Right, enough of my poor decisions. Quick updates first.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, go on.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I can't send the shift handover report round yet. I'm waiting on the permit to be signed, so that's held up.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Ah, right. Understood.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: My near-miss write-up at line three is all done. All fine.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers, Reidy.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Sorry, bit of a crackle at my end.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: You're clear now.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And I already swapped the filter on the water ring yesterday. That's sorted.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Lovely.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Right, what's new, then?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I'll go to the hydraulics lot to pick up the replacement parts for the Injection Moulding Line 3 at half two. It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: You're collecting them yourself, boss?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, I'll do the collection.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Half two is when you're going over, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, at half two. Not a rush trip now.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Fair enough. Otherwise everyone hears 'replacement parts' and assumes it's a panic.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Usually accompanied by someone standing behind you.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I feel very seen.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: It's the folded arms, boss.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, moving swiftly on.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah so, I'll book a contractor to look at the IM2 this morning.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Reidy. Whenever you get a chance this morning, no need to drop everything.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yep, that's fine.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: That's the booking this morning, not expecting someone through the gate this morning?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Exactly. I'll make the booking. Haven't promised an arrival time.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Good, that's what I thought you meant.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Contractor teleportation's still a bit unreliable.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Especially with the toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: While we're on timings, I'll schedule downtime for the Engel with production this afternoon. Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Sorry, Fi, I talked over the end there. You're doing the scheduling this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah. That's when I'll agree the downtime with production, not saying the machine's stopping this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fine, Fi. Normal priority is right.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Useful distinction. I heard it the other way round for a second.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, sorry. First coffee hasn't quite landed.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: One more thing: the monthly fire alarm test needs running at half two. Not an emergency but don't let it slip. Anyone able to take that?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Um...

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: I can't take that one.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Nor me, I'm afraid.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Sorry, no.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: I can't commit to that.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: No, sorry, neither can I.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. I can't cover it with the collection either. No owner for the fire alarm test, then; it still needs doing at half two.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah. Not an ideal clash.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No. Okay, that's where we are. Thanks, everyone.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Cheers.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: See you in a bit.
